quote: Don't hardcode `Dispatchers` when creating new coroutines or calling `withContext`.
note: Android 官方最佳實踐明寫要注入 Dispatcher;測試頁說明換成 TestDispatcher 才會跳過 delay、單執行緒確定性。

quote: Cancellation in coroutines is cooperative, which means that when a coroutine's `Job` is cancelled, the coroutine isn't cancelled until it suspends or checks for cancellation.
note: 同頁範例就是迴圈內 ensureActive();yield 的說法見 kotlinx 取消文件鏡像。

quote: Wrapping your test's code in `runTest` will work for testing basic suspending functions, and it will automatically skip any delays in coroutines
note: 頁面講 runTest 虛擬時間跳過 delay、advanceTimeBy;未逐字點名 runBlocking,但標準寫法與後果成立。

quote: so its `CoroutineExceptionHandler` has no effect either.
note: 頁面:子協程的 handler 永遠不會被用到(委派給 parent 到 root);async 的 handler 無效、例外在 await 取得。

quote: You cannot recover from the exception in the `CoroutineExceptionHandler`. The coroutine had already completed with the corresponding exception when the handler is called.
note: 與型錄後果一致。

quote: Every child should handle its exceptions by itself via the exception handling mechanism.
note: 頁面並說 supervision scope 的子協程失敗不往上傳;直接在 supervisorScope 內 launch 的子協程會用 scope 上的 handler。

quote: Failure of a child with an exception other than CancellationException immediately cancels its parent and, consequently, all its other children.
note: Job 頁講明子失敗取消 parent 與兄弟,可用 SupervisorJob 客製;ViewModel 頁官方範例即 CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + ...) 加 onCleared 時 coroutineScope.cancel()。

quote: these exceptions are ignored by all handlers, so they should be used only as the source of additional debug information
note: CancellationException 代表正常取消、被所有 handler 忽略,支持「繼承它當業務錯誤會靜默消失」;runCatching 吞掉部分是推論。

quote: Cancellation on timeout runs concurrently the code running in the block and may happen at any time, even after the block finishes executing but before the caller gets resumed with the result.
note: 取消指南(AOSP 鏡像 kotlinx 官方文件)的「Asynchronous timeout and resources」說資源可能洩漏,解法是把資源參照存在區塊外變數並在外面關閉。kotlinlang.org 的取消頁本身 WebFetch 回空,故用鏡像。

quote: The typical usage of NonCancellable is to ensure that cleanup code is executed even if the parent job is cancelled.
note: detekt SuspendFunInFinallySection:Report usage of suspending functions within a `finally` section that are not enclosed in a non-cancellable context.
查 CoroutineScope、Job、launch 官方 API 頁與搜尋,找不到官方原文說「cancel 後的 scope 再 launch 靜默不執行」。launch 文件只說協程可能在啟動前被取消;kotlinx GitHub issue #621 還指出 launch 不檢查 scope 是否已取消。cancelChildren 也沒有官方頁面講這個對比。只有論壇層級說法,不採。

quote: Coroutine cancellation is cooperative. A coroutine code has to cooperate to be cancellable.
note: Job API:cancelAndJoin 為「Cancels the job and suspends the invoking coroutine until the cancelled job is complete.」;取消指南說有 cancelAndJoin 把 cancel 與 join 合併。

quote: Calling runBlocking from a suspend function is redundant.
note: 頁面並說 redundant and blocks the thread、可能執行緒飢餓;未逐字出現「Main 上死鎖」,但核心主張成立。

quote: Only then can the coroutineScope call return a value.
note: 頁面:Job 在 block 與 scope 內所有啟動的協程都完成才結束,所以尾端 launch 照樣要等;「多餘」的判斷是由此推論,頁面未直接點名此寫法。

quote:
externalScope.launch { articlesDataSource.bookmarkArticle(article) }
            .join() // Wait for the coroutine to complete
note: 官方範例即標準寫法。

quote: When the `ViewModelStoreOwner` clears the ViewModel at the end of its lifecycle, the ViewModel also cancels the `CoroutineScope`.
note: MainScope 官方範例在 onDestroy 呼叫 scope.cancel();洩漏後果是由範例推論,頁面未逐字寫洩漏。

quote: ViewModels shouldn't hold any references of lifecycle-related APIs such as the `Context` or `Resources` to prevent memory leaks.
note: 另有最佳實踐頁要求 UI 事件經 StateFlow;核心(長壽元件不持有 UI/Context)成立。

quote: The unconfined dispatcher should not be used in general code.
note: 頁面並說恢復後的執行緒由被呼叫的 suspend 函式決定(Dispatchers.Unconfined API 頁亦同)。

quote: don't have to worry about what `Dispatcher` to use for what type of work. This responsibility lies in the class that does the work.
note: 頁面章節 Suspend functions should be safe to call from the main thread;「多一次切換」是推論。

quote: If the resulting context in which block should run has the same ContinuationInterceptor as the caller, no dispatch is performed.
note: 型錄後果寫「多餘的切換開銷」,但官方 withContext 文件說同 dispatcher 不會 dispatch(不切換);冗餘只剩一層呼叫成本,後果欄與原文相反,應改成「無實益、僅多一層巢狀」或降級。

quote: By default, the maximum number of threads used by this dispatcher is equal to the number of CPU cores, but is at least two.
note: IO 頁:The CoroutineDispatcher that is designed for offloading blocking IO tasks to a shared pool of threads;limitedParallelism 用法亦在同頁。

官方 API 頁(Dispatchers.IO、runBlocking)未寫 common/JS/iOS 可用性;只在 kotlinx GitHub issue #3205 有『Dispatchers.IO is only available for Kotlin/JVM according to the docs』的使用者敘述,且 Native 後來以擴充函式補上,不是權威頁面。expect/actual 頁只支持標準寫法,不支持壞寫法為何錯。

quote: The resulting ThreadContextElement maintains the given value of the given ThreadLocal for a coroutine regardless of the actual thread it is resumed on.
note: 與標準寫法一致。

quote: This function should always be preferred over kotlin.coroutines.coroutineContext property even when there is no explicit clash.
note: 頁面並有 ANTIPATTERN 範例展示遮蔽。

quote: a hundred coroutines increment the `counter` concurrently from multiple threads without any synchronization.
note: 頁面並介紹 AtomicInteger、Mutex、單執行緒限定。

quote: volatile variables guarantee linearizable (this is a technical term for "atomic") reads and writes to the corresponding variable, but do not provide atomicity of larger actions (increment in our case).
note: 與型錄一致。

quote: The key difference is that `Mutex.lock()` is a suspending function. It does not block a thread.
note: 頁面說阻塞世界用 synchronized 或 ReentrantLock,協程用 Mutex;「跨掛起點解鎖失敗/死鎖」未逐字出現。

quote: Suspend functions that use `CoroutineScope` as receiver should not be marked as `suspend`.
note: detekt 規則說明,與標準寫法一致;「預設關」未再逐項核對。

quote: it is better to name it explicitly for debugging purposes.
note: 頁面:CoroutineName 在除錯模式下會出現在執行緒名稱;原句為『when a coroutine is tied to the processing of a specific request or doing some specific background task, it is better to name it explicitly for debugging purposes.』

quote: It starts asynchronous work that callers need to wait for, but has no way to notify callers when that work is done.
note: 頁面並建議改成 suspend 或回傳 Deferred(launch 則回傳 Job 後 join)。
